rows.comment: Hover twin of pkgid-04: `extra_method` lives in WidgetExtra.pm, the losing file of the reopened `Shared::Widget` (Widget.pm wins by smallest-path). The hover cross-file arm reads the single `get_cached` winner, so hover answers nothing for a method the losing file defines.
Control: hover on the winner file's own method must keep answering after the candidate-set conversion.

`Shared::Panel` is split across Panel.pm (winner) and PanelHooks.pm (loser); ONLY the loser declares `use parent 'Shared::PanelBase'`. `parents_cached` is winner-keyed, so the inheritance edge is invisible and hover on the inherited `panel_render` answers nothing.
